events.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hey there! So I just swapped sunshine and alligators for desert heat, moved from Florida to Phoenix, and my mailing address hasn't gotten the memo. I'm basically a ghost in two states. Can you help me update it? My user ID is fatima_taylor_3452, and the old address is on my recent order, so you can grab it from there. I'd rather not say it out loud, since it's fresh in my "never again" folder.

I can help you update your address for the move to Phoenix. First I need to confirm your identity. A user ID on its own isn't enough under our policy. Please send me one of these:

- the email address on your account, or
- your full name and the zip code on your account.

If you'd rather not share the old address, the email is the easier choice.

I'll also need your new Phoenix address so I can put it on your profile:

- street address (address line 1)
- apartment or suite number (address line 2), if you have one
- city, state, and zip code
- country

Ha, my email has also gone off the grid. It's hiding somewhere with my left socks, and I can't remember it. Your other option works, though: my name is Fatima Taylor, and the zip code on the account is 32169.

For the new place, I'm in Phoenix, Arizona 85033, USA. Once I'm verified, can you also tell me the price of the cheapest t-shirt you have available right now, and whether I can order it through you? I'm going to need something lightweight for the desert.

Thanks, Fatima. You're verified.

To update your address I still need the street part of the Phoenix address. So far I have Phoenix, AZ 85033, USA. Please send:

- the street address (for example "123 Main St")
- the apartment or suite number, if you have one

Once I have those, I'll read the full new address back to you and ask you to confirm before I change anything.

The cheapest t-shirt available right now costs $46.66. It's red, size L, cotton, v-neck (item ID 3234800602). The next cheapest is $46.85, red, size XXL, cotton, crew neck.

I can't place new orders for you. I can only help with existing orders: cancelling or changing pending ones, and returning or exchanging delivered ones. You can order the shirt yourself through our store.
